column1: # ScholarChain ER candidate selection (work order DS-P5-01). Owner: dataset-engineer. Fixed record list.
# Columns (tab-separated): unit_id, criterion, source, kind, identifier, expect_doi, expect_author.
# Every identifier was returned by an official source query on 2026-11-05 (dblp SPARQL endpoint
# https://sparql.dblp.org/sparql, Crossref REST API); the queries and rules are in
# datasets/dataset-manifest.yaml (er_candidates.criteria). No entity-resolution policy, score, label,
# or match outcome was run, read, or consulted to choose or drop any row.
# expect_doi / expect_author are SELECTION FACTS checked against the extracted dblp record (the record
# must carry this DOI in an ee element, and an author element with exactly this text). They are not
# match labels: a shared name is never evidence of identity.
# kind: dblp/rec = offline excerpt of the pinned release dblp-2026-10-03 by record key (never requested from dblp.org); openalex/work-by-doi and crossref/work-by-doi =
# lookup by DOI; openalex/authors-of-work = the OpenAlex author records of that work's authorships.
